headline: Web developer & automation consultant
tagline: I build fast websites and wire up the boring parts of your business so they run themselves.
availability: Two project slots open this quarter
aboutText:
I'm Paolo, a developer based in Makati.

For six years I've helped agencies, online sellers, and professional practices ship websites that load fast and don't need a babysitter — then connected the back office: invoicing, inventory, leads, and reports, all flowing without copy-paste.

I work in sprints with fixed quotes. You always know what ships this week and what it costs.
servicesIntro: Fixed-scope builds, quoted before we start.

services.title: Websites & landing pages
services.description: Fast, mobile-first sites with your story, services, and a way to message you — measured against real speed scores.

services.title: Business automations
services.description: Forms to sheets to invoices. I connect the tools you already use so data enters once and goes everywhere.

services.title: Care & maintenance plans
services.description: Updates, backups, small changes, and a monthly report — so your site never quietly breaks.

work.description: Patients book online, records land in Airtable, reminders send themselves. Front-desk time on scheduling dropped by half.
Migrated a slow 4-second store to a static-first build that loads under a second on mobile data.
Quotations, contracts, and invoices generated from one form — no more weekend spreadsheet marathons.

testimonials.text: Paolo automated our booking mess in three weeks. Our front desk finally breathes.
testimonials.author: Dr. Kai Alvarez

testimonials.text: Fixed quote, weekly demos, no surprises. The site is twice as fast as the old one.
testimonials.author: Mika Santos

faq.question: How do you price projects?
faq.answer: Fixed quotes per sprint after one scoping call — you approve the number before any work starts.

faq.question: Do you support clients outside Metro Manila?
faq.answer: Yes — most of my work is remote, with calls scheduled in your time zone.

contactIntro: Tell me what's slowing you down. I reply within one working day.
messengerNote: Opens Messenger with your message ready to send.
